items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: John was coming along with the band... I joined Tadd... John stayed with the band

ctx.x: So, well, we worked around a little bit, you know, and John was coming along with the band. Sometimes he would stay in New York and so forth. So one day we played the Apollo Theater. So Monk and I went to the Braddock Bar to

have a drink during the half hour, you know. So we were there, drinking beer and talking and laughing. So I looked at my watch, I said, "Oh, my God, Monk, we missed the half hour." And he said, "Oh, oh." So some way I said, "We better get out of here." He said, "Yeah, we better." So we ran backstage and there was Milt Jackson, sitting up on the drums, but behind the curtain I sneaked up under the curtain and sneaked up on the stand, I said, "Bags, hey Bags." So Bags, he said, "Is that you, Klook Klunk?" I said,…
